## PR title prefix

Remember your PR **title** (not this description) needs to start with one of:
`other:`, `cont:`, `feat:`, `feat!:`, `fix:` — otherwise the Label Check
workflow will fail and it won't be picked up by the changelog. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details on which prefix to use.

## Checklist

- [ ] I've run `black .` on any Python files I touched, then `git push`
- [ ] Each game's files stay self-contained within its own folder
      (`mainfile/<Game>/` and/or `docs/<game>.html`)
- [ ] I followed the existing code style for the game I'm touching
- [ ] I've tested this locally (terminal and/or browser version, as applicable)
- [ ] I've included tests where applicable
- [ ] If this adds a brand-new game, it was approved in the Discussions tab first
